walkthrough: Identify the energy transfer: released from rest with no air resistance, so loss in gravitational potential energy equals gain in kinetic energy.
Write $mgh = KE$ with $m = 40 \text{ kg}$, $h = 20 \text{ m}$ and $KE = 32 \text{ kJ} = 32000 \text{ J}$.
Solve for the field strength: $g = 32000/800 = 40 \text{ m s}^{-2}$.
Calculate weight on the surface: $W = mg = 40 \times 40 = 1600 \text{ N} = 1.6 \text{ kN}$.
